mapper.insert: insert into dh_import_job( job_no, preview_id, dataset_id, operation_type, status, phase, source_file_name, stored_file_path, file_type, file_hash, sheet_name, proposed_display_name, proposed_physical_name, schema_snapshot_json, staging_table_name, target_table_name, total_rows, processed_rows, success_rows, failed_rows, error_message, upload_user_id, upload_user_name, expire_time, start_time, finish_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{jobNo}, #{previewId}, #{datasetId}, #{operationType}, #{status}, #{phase}, #{sourceFileName}, #{storedFilePath}, #{fileType}, #{fileHash}, #{sheetName}, #{proposedDisplayName}, #{proposedPhysicalName}, #{schemaSnapshotJson}, #{stagingTableName}, #{targetTableName}, coalesce(#{totalRows}, 0), coalesce(#{processedRows}, 0), coalesce(#{successRows}, 0), coalesce(#{failedRows}, 0), #{errorMessage}, #{uploadUserId}, #{uploadUserName}, #{expireTime}, #{startTime}, #{finishTime}, sysdate(3), sysdate(3) )
mapper.update: update dh_import_job set status = 'PENDING_CONFIRM', phase = '等待确认', sheet_name = #{sheetName}, proposed_display_name = #{proposedDisplayName}, proposed_physical_name = #{proposedPhysicalName}, total_rows = #{totalRows}, processed_rows = 0, success_rows = 0, failed_rows = 0, error_message = null, start_time = null, finish_time = null, update_time = sysdate(3) where job_id = #{jobId} and status in ('PENDING_CONFIRM', 'VALIDATION_FAILED', 'FAILED') and expire_time > sysdate(3)

update dh_import_job set status = 'QUEUED', phase = '等待执行', proposed_display_name = #{displayName}, proposed_physical_name = #{physicalName}, schema_snapshot_json = #{schemaJson}, error_message = null, processed_rows = 0, success_rows = 0, failed_rows = 0, start_time = null, finish_time = null, update_time = sysdate(3) where preview_id = #{previewId} and upload_user_id = #{userId} and status in ('PENDING_CONFIRM', 'VALIDATION_FAILED', 'FAILED') and expire_time > sysdate(3) and ((sheet_name = #{expectedSheetName}) or (sheet_name is null and #{expectedSheetName} is null))

update dh_import_job set status = 'VALIDATING', phase = '等待执行', start_time = sysdate(3), lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_time = sysdate(3) where preview_id = #{previewId} and status = 'QUEUED'

update dh_import_job set status = 'QUEUED', phase = '等待执行', start_time = null, update_time = sysdate(3) where preview_id = #{previewId} and lock_version = #{lockVersion} and status = 'VALIDATING' and phase = '等待执行'
mapper.select: select preview_id from dh_import_job where status = 'QUEUED' order by job_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update dh_import_job set status = 'QUEUED', phase = '等待恢复', processed_rows = 0, success_rows = 0, failed_rows = 0, error_message = null, start_time = null, finish_time = null, lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_time = sysdate(3) where status in ('VALIDATING', 'STAGING', 'COMMITTING', 'RECOVERING') and update_time < #{staleBefore}

update dh_import_job set status = 'FAILED', phase = '预览中断', error_message = '服务重启导致预览中断，请重新上传', finish_time = sysdate(3), update_time = sysdate(3) where status = 'PARSING' and update_time < #{staleBefore}
mapper.select: select count(1) from dh_import_job where job_id = #{jobId} and lock_version = #{lockVersion} and status = #{status}
mapper.update: update dh_import_job set status = 'FAILED', phase = #{phase}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, success_rows = 0, finish_time = #{finishTime}, update_time = sysdate(3) where job_id = #{jobId} and lock_version = #{lockVersion} and status in ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'STAGING', 'COMMITTING', 'RECOVERING')
mapper.select: select * from dh_import_job where preview_id = #{previewId}

select * from dh_import_job where stored_file_path != '' and expire_time < sysdate(3) and status in ('PENDING_CONFIRM', 'VALIDATION_FAILED', 'FAILED', 'SUCCESS', 'MANUAL_REQUIRED') order by job_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update dh_import_job set stored_file_path = '', update_time = sysdate(3) where job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.select: select * from dh_import_job where dataset_id = #{datasetId} order by job_id desc limit 100
